title: Go-Bag Inventory Items Present Leaderboard
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gobag:inventory items_present=*
| stats sum(items_present) as total_value, avg(items_present) as avg_value by bag_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks go bag values by total and average items present across go-bag inventory events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `items_present` values for each go-bag inventory event and review total and average items present by go bag.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total items present.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which go bag shows the biggest items present numbers in your go-bag inventory data.
